suspects.name: Vikram Singh
suspects.personality: Ambitious, volatile, and prone to outbursts.
suspects.physicalDescription: A man in his mid-40s with sharp features, a stern expression, and impeccably tailored but slightly worn clothing. He has dark, slicked-back hair and piercing eyes that seem to scrutinize everything. His posture is rigid.
suspects.trueAlibi: He was at the victim's estate, argued with the victim, and committed the murder.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was at the bar across town the entire evening, drowning my sorrows over my business troubles.
suspects.trueMotive: Revenge for perceived sabotage of his business and financial ruin.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He has significant gambling debts and recently lost a major business deal due to the victim's interference.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes defensive when asked about his whereabouts specifically between 9 PM and 10 PM. His hands may tremble slightly.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Arjun Mehta has always been ambitious and might have clashed with the victim over business. He also knows Priya Sharma is the victim's estranged niece and might have financial motives.

suspects.name: Priya Sharma
suspects.personality: Reserved, observant, and carries a quiet sadness. She is often overlooked but misses little.
suspects.physicalDescription: A young woman in her late twenties with a delicate frame, large, expressive eyes, and long, dark hair often tied back simply. She prefers elegant but understated clothing, often in muted colors. She has a small mole near her lip.
suspects.trueAlibi: She was in the garden, trying to get some fresh air, and overheard a heated argument followed by a thud from the study.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I retired to my room with a headache before the commotion started. I heard nothing.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: She was secretly in love with the victim's son, who passed away years ago, and the victim blamed her for his death.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Vikram Singh has a fierce rivalry with the victim and has seen them argue publicly. She also knows Arjun Mehta was always trying to get ahead in business and was frequently at the estate.

suspects.name: Arjun Mehta
suspects.personality: Smooth-talking, ambitious, and outwardly charming, but with a calculating edge.
suspects.physicalDescription: A well-dressed man in his late thirties, with a confident swagger and a ready smile. He has a long nose and usually sports a well-maintained mustache. He wears fashionable, expensive clothing.
suspects.trueAlibi: He was in the study looking for the victim to discuss a minor business matter, but left before the argument and murder.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was admiring the art collection in the west wing during the time of the incident. I barely knew Ramesh.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He was recently investigated for financial irregularities in a previous project and was hoping the victim would provide an alibi or character reference.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Priya Sharma is the victim's niece and that their relationship was strained. He also knows Vikram Singh and the victim had a very public and acrimonious business rivalry.

suspects.name: Dr. Ananya Rao
suspects.personality: Calm, collected, and professional, but with a hint of weariness. She speaks with precision.
suspects.physicalDescription: A woman in her mid-50s with neatly styled grey hair, sharp, intelligent eyes behind glasses, and a kind but serious demeanor. She wears conservative, professional attire, often a sweater vest over a blouse.
suspects.trueAlibi: She was in her private study in a separate wing of the estate, reviewing patient files.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was in my private study in a separate wing of the estate, reviewing patient files. I heard nothing unusual.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Priya Sharma has been struggling with grief over her deceased fiancé. She is aware of the deep-seated animosity between Vikram Singh and the victim. She knows Arjun Mehta is a shrewd businessman who often tried to get the victim's attention.
